license_review: REQUIRED BEFORE ANY RELEASE, and unresolved. Inherits issue #40 from the ldx lineage. The encoder, loss and decode are leech.crf with no bonito or ont-koi in the training path, but the label chain runs dorado and the per-read labels come from a shipped ldx bundle whose own licence review is open.

training.label_source: The 3' ldx barcode, called by barcode_crf_nbc16_rna004@v0.3.0 and mapped to an fdx code through config/fdx4_libraries.yaml. Reads gated on carrying >=80% of the 77-nt adapter, measured from the tRNA 5' alignment edge to the read end (scripts/fdx/adapter_span.py). The label channel is the 3' end read from signal by a trained model; the training signal is the 5' end. Independent.
training.dataset: 20260828_FDX1-4_Demux Run1 (PBK54437), acylated E. coli MG1655, RNA004. Five libraries: fdx01-fdx04 with the plain 3' adapter and fdx01 again with EDX7, three ldx codes each. 175,584 labelled reads after the reach gate -- fdx01 60,186 / fdx02 48,657 / fdx03 30,612 / fdx04 36,129. fdx01 leads because it appears in two libraries, which the measured read shares (0.610/0.627) independently agree with.

metrics.split: the corpus's recorded held-out split, carved per code BEFORE the cap by extract_chunks.py, so these reads were never trained on
metrics.note: Reported per run, never pooled: for ldx the pilot aliases code identity with flowcell (issue #26), and for a panel whose codes are crossed with batch the run is the only honest holdout. Edit distances are against the reference the model EMITS (target[state_len:]); scoring against the full-length target inflates every distance and compresses the margin (issue #36).

notes: FOUR codes, trained on ONE flow cell. Run2 is now fully processed -- basecalled, aligned, spanned and demuxed -- and is deliberately NOT in this model's corpus (`manifest_runs: [Run1]`), so it stands as a held-out replicate rather than training data. Scoring these weights on it is the honest cross-batch number and the cheap first answer to #99. Training on both runs was measured and is NOT what shipped: at the same training budget that arm had 4-8x the seed spread (sd 0.0076 against 0.0009, range 0.9466-0.9670 over six seeds) and its best seed still did not beat this corpus's best. See dev-notes/fdx-corpus-arms.md. fdx01/fdx02 reuse the ldx01/ldx02 codes, so per-code accuracy on those two against the ldx model's on the same codes is the cleanest available cross-panel comparison.
